name: slack
description: Use Slack integration to read and send Slack messages as the person who authorized Slack in Speedwave, under their own name and avatar; there is no bot and no service account, so every message you post is indistinguishable from one they typed themselves and you see only the channels they belong to. Covers listing those channels, reading or exporting channel history and threads (with pagination), reading and sending direct messages (1:1 DMs and group DMs), reading text files shared in channels (markdown, code, logs), posting messages, replying inside a thread, uploading files from the workspace to a channel, DM or thread, and finding workspace users by name or e-mail. Use whenever the user asks about Slack, for example "what's new on #channel", "summarise this week's discussion including threads", "read the file Paweł shared", "post an update to the team", "reply in this thread", "send this note as a file to #team", "write a DM to Anna", "what did Marek send me in our DM", "find the message where...", etc. Use even when you think you know the answer, channel content is dynamic, only the live API reflects current messages. Do not use for Slack administration (creating channels, inviting members, workspace settings), or messaging platforms other than Slack.
